title: EventStagedInviteeEmail - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between an event and an email address invited to the event that doesn’t match to a user, contact, or lead record. Data about the unmatched email address is represented in StagedInviteeEmail. This object represents event-related details, such as the invitee's attendance response to the event. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

EventId.description: The unique ID of the related event record. This field is a relationship field.

IsArchived.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsArchived.description: Indicates whether the event is archived (true) or not (false). This value helps manage high volumes of archived events, improving query performance. The default value is false.

IsOrganizer.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsOrganizer.description: Indicates whether the invitee is the event organizer (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

StagedInviteeEmailId.description: The unique ID of the related invitee email address record. This field is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The attendance response to the event from the invitee. Possible values are: Accepted Declined Maybe New Uninvited

special_access_rules: This object is available with Einstein Activity Capture when Sync Email as Salesforce Activity is turned on.
